user_can_queue_arbitrary_withdrawals_occ.meaning: a user queued an arbitrary number of withdrawals with arbitrary share amounts via queueWithdrawal
user_can_queue_arbitrary_withdrawals_occ.checkpoint: before admin processing of queued withdrawals

spam_request_share_amount.meaning: amount of shares in a spam withdrawal request (1 share)
spam_request_share_amount.checkpoint: before admin processing of queued withdrawals

queued_requests_count.meaning: number of queued withdrawal requests in _queuedWithdrawal
queued_requests_count.checkpoint: before admin processing of queued withdrawals

loop_bounded_by_request_count.meaning: looping over the queue is structured so it does not grow unbounded with the number of queued requests

admin_processing_reverts_out_of_gas.meaning: admin processing of queued withdrawals runs out of gas and reverts the tx
admin_processing_reverts_out_of_gas.checkpoint: during admin processing of queued withdrawals

assumptions: The queue processing loop is the operation whose completion is required.
The number of queued requests is observable from _queuedWithdrawal length.

unresolved.description: The intent requires the loop not grow unbounded with the number of queued requests, but the report gives no numeric bound or batch size; loop_bounded_by_request_count is a qualitative Boolean whose binding is deferred.

limitations: The impact is potential; the V witness is encoded as a Boolean occurrence of the out-of-gas revert rather than an inevitable outcome.
No concrete batch size or gas threshold is stated in the report.
